findings.summary: Forcing PagingMode::Never for --list-themes reverses paging the project added on purpose (#3239) and defended with a follow-up fix (#3457); also overrides explicit --paging=always
No changelog entry for a behavior change, which CONTRIBUTING requires and CI checks
Fix and new test were never compiled or run (cargo unavailable)
Override leaves the --list-themes stdin guard dead; post-match overwrite reads worse than handling in the match

why: Finding 1 says paging for --list-themes was deliberately added recently (#3239, #3457) and the PR reverses that choice, which is the maintainer's reason.
